ارتعفتم (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَفْتُمْ (irtaʕaftum) /ir.ta.ʕaf.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اُرْتُعِفْتُمْ (urtuʕiftum) /ur.tu.ʕif.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
